birth.stop: Torhout, a birth the sources cannot agree on
birth.date_confidence: traditional; year conventional, birthplace disputed. German Wikipedia and the Oekumenisches Heiligenlexikon give Flemish nobility near Torhout; English Wikipedia states that historians widely accept a Danish origin. Neither position is adjudicated here, and the pin sits at Torhout only because it is the one named place either tradition offers.
